title: I Am Unworthy
text: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant.

title: A Gift for Esau
text: … he selected a gift for his brother Esau

title: Israel
text: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel …

title: Face to Face
text: Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.

title: Esau Ran to Him
text: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.

title: Like Seeing the Face of God
text: … I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God …

title: The Camp of God
text: This is the camp of God.

title: Twenty Years
text: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household …

title: Judah
text: “This time I will praise the LORD.” So she named him Judah.

title: Kind and Tenderhearted
text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
